name: multi-server-shards
title: Add multi-server game shards
creator: oversky
notes: WIP sync 2026-05-16: multi-server shard code compiles and focused attribute calculator test passes. Fixed transfer cancellation undefined variable, admin transfer server binding, sponsor alt-account same-server checks, guild applicant lookup by server, and added explicit servers/server_profiles. Follow-up audit under the rule 'legacy-server resources must not transfer into a new server' patched red envelopes, invitation rewards, relationship gifts/equipment transfers, spirit-field steal/visit, divine-punishment drops, VIP carry teleport targets, guild kick target lookup, account-switching UID command entrypoints, and admin item transfer. Not yet recommended for full production rollout: full test suite has existing environment/import issues, and database migration plus manual shard-isolation smoke tests should be run on a database copy before opening a new server. New-server UID restart is possible but requires a separate migration from global player.uid uniqueness to a (server_id, uid) uniqueness model.

last_validation.known_test_gap: full tests are blocked by existing missing adapter/dependency issues; SQLite auto-migration smoke is blocked because plugin import loads configured MySQL engine and aiomysql is missing
